units.source_text: 明石浦上也得悉了女御诞生小皇子之消息。

en.t: News also reached the Akashi shore that the lady had given birth to a young imperial prince.

units.source_text: 看破红尘的明石道人也非常欢喜，对众弟子说：

en.t: The Akashi holy man, who had renounced worldly attachments, was greatly delighted as well, and said to his disciples:

units.source_text: “如今我可安心地脱离尘世，往生极乐了！”

en.t: Now I can leave this dusty world in peace and be reborn in paradise.

units.source_text: 就把住宅改成寺院，附近所有田地及一切器物都捐作寺产，准备入山去了。

en.t: He then turned his residence into a temple, donated all the nearby fields and every furnishing as temple property, and prepared to withdraw into the mountains.

units.source_text: 这播磨国地方有一个郡，其中有一座人迹罕通的深山。

en.t: In that region of Harima Province there was a district containing a deep mountain rarely visited by people.

units.source_text: 明石道人于多年前购置此山，预备将来笼闭其中，不再与世人相见。

en.t: Many years earlier, the Akashi holy man had bought this mountain, intending one day to shut himself away there and see no one from the world again.

units.source_text: 只因在世间略有牵累之事，故迁延至今不曾如愿。

en.t: Because he still had a few worldly ties, however, he had delayed until now and had not yet fulfilled that wish.

units.source_text: 如今闻知外孙女喜讯，便一切放心，准备移居深山，献身神佛了。

en.t: Now that he had heard the joyful news about his granddaughter, he felt entirely at ease and prepared to move into the deep mountains and devote himself to the gods and buddhas.

units.source_text: 近年来明石道人并无特别事由，久不遣使入京。

en.t: In recent years, the Akashi holy man had had no special reason to send messengers to the capital, and had long refrained from doing so.

units.source_text: 只有京中遣使来明石浦时，略复三言两语，将近况告知老尼姑。

en.t: Only when messengers came from the capital to Akashi would he send back a brief word or two and let the old nun know how things stood.

units.source_text: 但现在他要离去尘世了，故写了一封长信送与明石夫人。

en.t: But now that he was about to leave the world behind, he wrote a long letter and sent it to the Lady of Akashi.

units.source_text: 信中言道：

en.t: In the letter he wrote:

units.source_text: “近数年来，我与你等生在同一世间。

en.t: For these past several years, I have lived in the same world as you all.

units.source_text: 虽然如此，我似觉此身已入另一世间了。

en.t: Even so, I have felt as though this body had already entered another world.

units.source_text: 故无特别事故，不与你等通问。

en.t: For that reason, unless there was some special matter, I did not exchange letters with you.

units.source_text: 且我看惯汉文经典，阅读假名书信颇费时间，念佛也会因此而懈怠，实乃无益之事。

en.t: Moreover, being accustomed to Chinese Buddhist texts, I found kana letters quite time-consuming to read, and they made me neglect my chanting of the Buddha's name, which was truly of no benefit.

units.source_text: 为此久不写信与你。

en.t: That is why I have not written to you for so long.

units.source_text: 今据人传言：

en.t: Now, according to what people have told me:

units.source_text: 外孙女已入宫为太子妃，且已诞生一小皇子。

en.t: My granddaughter has entered the palace as the Crown Prince's consort, and has given birth to a young imperial prince.

units.source_text: 闻之深为庆喜。

en.t: Hearing this, I rejoice deeply.

units.source_text: 此事自有原因，今日我可告你：

en.t: There is a reason for this, and today I can tell it to you:

units.source_text: 我自身乃一拙陋之山野鄙夫，不复贪恋现世荣华。

en.t: I myself am only a clumsy and lowly man of the mountains and fields, and I no longer long for worldly splendor.

units.source_text: 但过去多年以来，六根未净，昼夜六时勤修之时，首先为你之事向佛祈愿，而将自己往生极乐之事置之次位。

en.t: Yet for many years, my six senses still impure, whenever I practiced diligently through the six watches of day and night, I first prayed to the Buddha for your sake, placing my own rebirth in paradise second.

units.source_text: 你诞生之年，二月中某夜我做一梦，梦见我右手托着须弥山，日月从山左右升起，光辉灿烂，遍照世间。

en.t: In the year you were born, one night in the middle of the second month I had a dream: with my right hand I held up Mount Sumeru, and the sun and moon rose from its left and right, shining brilliantly over the whole world.

units.source_text: 而我自己隐身于山之阴，不受日月之光。

en.t: But I myself hid in the shadow of the mountain and did not receive the light of the sun and moon.

units.source_text: 后来我将山放入大海，使浮水上，自己乘一小船向西驶去了。

en.t: Afterward I placed the mountain in the great sea and made it float upon the water, while I boarded a small boat and sailed westward.

units.source_text: 梦中所见如此。

en.t: That was what I saw in the dream.

units.source_text: 梦醒之后，心中时时筹思：

en.t: After waking from the dream, I kept pondering in my heart:

units.source_text: 想不到我此微不足数之身，将来亦有发迹之望。

en.t: Could it be that even this insignificant self of mine has some hope of rising in the future?

units.source_text: 然而何所凭借，而能交此大运呢？

en.t: But by what means could I ever encounter such great fortune?

units.source_text: 正在此时，你母诞生了你。

en.t: Just then, your mother gave birth to you.

units.source_text: 我检阅世俗书籍，考查佛教经典，发现做梦可信之事例甚多。

en.t: I examined secular books and studied Buddhist scriptures, and found many examples showing that dreams can be trusted.

units.source_text: 因此不管自家身世之微贱，尽心竭力地教养你。

en.t: Therefore, disregarding the lowliness of my own station, I devoted all my strength to raising you.

units.source_text: 然而又念能力毕竟有限，此梦终难应验，便辞去京都，返归乡里。

en.t: Yet thinking that my abilities were limited after all and that the dream would be difficult to fulfill, I left the capital and returned to my home province.

units.source_text: 自任播磨国守之后，决心在此终老，不再入京。

en.t: After becoming governor of Harima Province, I resolved to grow old and die here, never returning to the capital.

units.source_text: 但在蛰居此浦多年之间，亦因对你的前程抱有极大之期望，故曾私下对佛许下许多祈愿。

en.t: But during the many years I lived secluded on this shore, because I held such great hopes for your future, I privately made many vows and prayers to the Buddha.

units.source_text: 现在夙愿顺利达成，你已如意称心。

en.t: Now my long-cherished wish has been smoothly fulfilled, and your hopes have come true.

units.source_text: 将来外孙女做了国母，大愿圆满之时，你必须赴住吉大寺以及其他诸寺还愿。

en.t: When your daughter one day becomes the mother of the realm and the great vow is fulfilled, you must go to the great temple of Sumiyoshi and to the other temples to repay those vows.

units.source_text: 我对此梦毫不怀疑。

en.t: I have not the slightest doubt about this dream.

units.source_text: 今此一愿既已迅速成就，则我将来往生遥隔十万亿国土之极乐世界时，亦必身登九品中之上品上生无疑。

en.t: Since this one wish has now been fulfilled so swiftly, when I am reborn in the Pure Land of bliss, ten trillion worlds away, I too will surely attain the highest birth among the nine grades.

units.source_text: 现在我只要静待佛菩萨来迎接我。

en.t: Now I need only wait quietly for the Buddha and bodhisattvas to come and welcome me.

units.source_text: 在这期间，我将在‘水草多清趣’的深山中勤修佛法，直到圆寂之时。

en.t: Until then, I will practice the Buddhist law diligently in the deep mountains where the waters and grasses have much pure charm, until the time of my passing.

units.source_text: 正是：

en.t: Thus it was:
